description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryService class within the namespace OrangeHRM\Pim\Service. It provides a service layer for handling employee salary data by managing an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao, which it initializes lazily. The class offers a method to retrieve the DAO, creating it if it does not already exist.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryService
classes.description: A service class providing access to employee salary data via a Data Access Object (DAO), with lazy initialization.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaryDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeSalaryDao instance, creating it if it doesn't already exist.
